python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestRepository
python_interfaces.rule: reader is an LLD-01 Snapshot or current UnitOfWork as appropriate; authoritative identity checks inside a command use the current UoW, no business ID is PK, and repositories never commit internally

python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestReferenceRepository
python_interfaces.rule: owns only SR-to-reference relationship history in schema/sr-reference-context.json; Customer/Contact master rows and Contact affiliation remain LLD-02 authority

python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestReferenceService
python_interfaces.contract: Customer replacement supersedes/inserts history and invokes LLD-06 classification participant in the same UoW. Contact association validates LLD-02 identity/current affiliation, preserves organization-at-use context, and never mutates Contact identity/affiliation. current_handler_reference requires exact current accepted Current Handler source observation and never creates a local handler authority. The reference token binds SR revision, active relationship identities, target reference revisions/current affiliation identity, and exact supporting source observation where applicable.

python_interfaces.name: RfcRepository
python_interfaces.rule: authoritative exact-number/revision/archive checks use the current UoW and role/source lifecycle are never stored as competing flags on the identity row

python_interfaces.name: RfcHierarchyRepository
python_interfaces.rule: all hierarchy writes run through RfcHierarchyService; cascade capture uses current-UoW reads

python_interfaces.name: SrRfcRelationshipRepository
python_interfaces.rule: direct links only; inherited subordinate context is query-derived

python_interfaces.name: DeviceReferenceRepository
python_interfaces.rule: contains no Network Element persistence authority

python_interfaces.name: TicketDeviceRelationshipRepository
python_interfaces.rule: closed target_type dispatch to owner-specific static SQL; no dynamic table names from client input

python_interfaces.name: WorkingNoteRepository
python_interfaces.rule: closed owner dispatch; note creation receives creating Local User Profile identity only from trusted authenticated command context; creator/creation time/owner are immutable and import code receives no note writer

python_interfaces.name: RfcLifecycleRepository
python_interfaces.rule: projection is current/rebuildable; cascade/archive membership/history is immutable except governed proposal state transitions

python_interfaces.name: RfcHistoryRiskProvider
python_interfaces.rule: bounded indexed checks only; indeterminate fails closed

python_interfaces.name: RfcSourceEvidenceProvider
python_interfaces.rule: LLD-04 owns immutable published source observation/provenance and versioned source vocabulary/precedence; LLD-03 owns accepted current RFC projection and never parses raw workbook content

python_interfaces.name: SrSourceEvidenceProvider
python_interfaces.rule: validation resolves exact source_observation_fields -> source_observations -> published advanced_search_sr run and proves canonical SR identity, field key, typed value/value-state and profile/vocabulary authority. LLD-03 stores the exact FK and never parses raw workbook rows.

python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestImportReader
python_interfaces.rule: base token includes SR revision, current source projection pointers/revision, active Customer/Contact relationship identities, referenced Customer/Contact revisions/current Contact affiliation identity and exact supporting source observation needed by the proposal kind

python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestImportMutationService
python_interfaces.contract: LLD-04 owns the outer accepted-proposal command receipt/UoW and exact immutable source/proposal evidence. LLD-03 revalidates SR identity/revision/current projection/reference state, writes only LLD-03 owned tables, invokes required LLD-02/06 participants in the same UoW, adds owner audit/result evidence, and never commits or creates another receipt. Current Handler source text is changed only by apply_accepted_source_projection; set_current_handler_contact_reference_from_review may resolve identity for the exact current handler observation but cannot supply a local handler value.

python_interfaces.name: RfcImportMutationService
python_interfaces.rule: LLD-04 outer proposal-acceptance command supplies already-open UnitOfWork and one command_context/command_id. These methods run all LLD-03 authoritative checks and add required owner audit/result rows but never commit/rollback or create a second command_receipt. accept_provisional_implement_eligibility_from_wfm may establish only a visibly provisional implement-eligible RFC projection supported by exact WFM evidence when no stronger accepted Enhanced RFC status blocks it; it never fabricates Enhanced RFC status. When invoked as a standalone LLD-03 command wrapper rather than from LLD-04, that wrapper creates the same single receipt before receipt-FK children. Terminal source projection retains terminal-epoch + pending-cascade atomicity and never executes the cascade.

python_interfaces.name: ServiceRequestCustomerClassificationParticipant
python_interfaces.rule: invoked only when canonical SR Customer changes, including clearing it; incompatible current CPL classification is invalidated with history in caller UoW and no replacement is silently selected

python_interfaces.name: RfcTerminalTaskParticipant
python_interfaces.rule: participant owns WFM/Task/Objective lifecycle and commits nothing independently; apply runs inside caller's UnitOfWork

python_interfaces.name: RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant
python_interfaces.rule: participant owns Communication links/frozen summary/orphan grace and commits nothing independently; accepted terminal evidence alone never calls apply

python_interfaces.name: RfcInventoryDependencyProvider
python_interfaces.rule: Inventory cannot be deleted or rewritten to manufacture RFC hard-delete eligibility

python_interfaces.name: DeliberateActionProofVerifier
python_interfaces.owner: LLD-12 authenticated-session/action-proof boundary with LLD-10 interaction contract
python_interfaces.rule: proof is server/session-bound evidence for the governed deliberate interaction; a client-supplied boolean/timestamp is never sufficient

python_interfaces.name: SrSourceProjectionService
python_interfaces.owner: LLD-03 Advanced Search acceptance boundary in cooperation with HLD-05
python_interfaces.rule: field precedence, structural allowlist/value-kind checks, exact LLD-04 source_observation_field FK validation, explicit Current Handler clear and compact observation history are defined in schema/sr-source-projection.json and algorithms/sr-source-current.json

python_interfaces.name: DeviceReferenceResolutionReader
python_interfaces.rule: read-only derived registration context; LLD-03 never writes Network Elements or changes relationship target identity

reader_contract: Any repository/service method named reader accepts only a framework-owned read abstraction bound either to a stable Snapshot or the current UnitOfWork. Commands that require authoritative uniqueness/revision/relationship/lifecycle decisions must use the current UnitOfWork reader and must not rely on a pre-lock Snapshot result.
cross_domain_transaction_rule: Import mutation services, SR Customer classification participation and terminal-cascade participant apply methods receive the already-open LLD-01 UnitOfWork, may mutate only their owned tables, never commit/rollback independently, and return immutable result references for LLD-01 audit_event_results. Exactly one outer command receipt exists per accepted cross-domain command. Any required participant failure or INDETERMINATE result aborts the transaction.
hard_delete_guard_rule: Preview/commit combine LLD-03 local relationship/note/archive/history checks with RfcSourceEvidenceProvider, RfcTerminalTaskParticipant, RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant and RfcInventoryDependencyProvider. Every provider must be determinate CLEAR; otherwise deletion fails closed.
cross_domain_rules: LLD-03 references LLD-02 Customer/Contact/Local User Profile IDs but edits no LLD-02 master identity or Contact affiliation through ticket repositories.
Canonical SR Customer and Contact relationships are LLD-03 history-preserving relationship authority; LLD-02 owns the referenced master identities and affiliation history.

Current Handler remains source-owned LLD-04 evidence projected through LLD-03; an SR current_handler_reference Contact is only a reviewed resolution of the exact current source observation and never a competing local handler state.

LLD-04 owns SR/RFC/WFM workbook staging/evidence and proposal/disposition authority and may submit accepted SR/RFC changes only through ServiceRequestImportMutationService/RfcImportMutationService; it cannot bypass LLD-03 identity/reference/lifecycle services.
LLD-06 consumes canonical SR Customer through the LLD-03 reference boundary and participates in Customer changes solely to invalidate incompatible classification without silently remapping.
LLD-05 owns WFM/Task lifecycle; Tickets captures/revalidates WFM identity only as cascade evidence and never writes Task lifecycle directly.
LLD-08 owns DeviceReference-to-NetworkElement resolution and Infrastructure entities; Ticket links remain DeviceReference FKs.
LLD-09 owns Communication links/retention; Tickets can coordinate the explicit terminal cascade only through the bounded same-UoW participant interface.
